content.text: It’s funny how different people bring out different sides of you. I feel tremendous peace lately but honestly I feel like my goofy side just doesn’t come out as often anymore. The trip was so fun and it was nice having Warren there. It’s been a while since I really hung out with him. I notice my childlike self comes out around him. I said this to him and he said, “You’ve been holding it in boy!“ A part of me feels like this is true.
It was great being there for Rachel and the trip went pretty smoothly outside the first night due to Emma going through breakup woes. The boating day went by quickly and was awesome.

The drive back turn unexpectedly theological after Warren asked about if I believed in aliens. Then to why I always say “right?” when I talk; then to how to know when to change; then to if I think my viewpoint is superior to those in our friend group; then to residual anger and resentment coming out with my friendship with Ryan; how my love prior to coming to the faith didn’t help anyone; to then to how I feel if nobody comes to my for advice due to my beliefs, then to a statement that hurts me. Warren said  “when he sees me he is terrified.” My heart sunk and asked “why do you feel that way?” He said  “if I were to come back and be a Christian, I don’t think I can reach where you are at and I would fail.”

I tried to reassure him that God has made us all different and it’s such a deeply personable one that our faith will show in such diverse ways. He meets you where you are at and that I am not perfect, I struggle with resentment and many other things. The Lord comes to us where we are and as long as we reside in Christ he will make changes within us. Those changes will show up in the world differently for each believer and brought up what Paul says on how each one of us is a body part in the Body of Christ.

Lord is the way I am acting pushing my friends away from God? I know this is not anything to deal with me but from Warren’s insecurity, but my heart still hurts and feels otherwise. I just want my friends to know you Lord. When I look towards you Lord, I see my own iniquities and at times doubt if I will persevere and finish the race you have for me. The changes you made within me are apparent, but please don’t let it scare others away!
